name: browser_extension
description: Passive DOM sensor for Gamblock AI on Windows. Reads textual page content (title, headings, anchor text) and forwards it to the local **Windows Service** over an authenticated WebSocket for on-device AI classification.

scripts.lint: node --check background.js && node --check background/*.js && node --check content_script.js && node --check options.js && npm run validate:extension
scripts.verify: npm run verify:context:local && npm run lint
